class.name: OcgBrepprimapiMakerevol
class.brief_description: Class to make revolved sweep topologies.
class.description: ! Class to make revolved sweep topologies. ! ! a revolved sweep is defined by : ! ! * A basis topology which is swept. ! ! The basis topology must not contain solids ! (neither composite solids.). ! ! The basis topology may be copied or shared in ! the result. ! ! * A rotation axis and angle : ! ! - The axis is an Ax1 from gp. ! ! - The angle is in [0, 2*Pi]. ! ! - The angle default value is 2*Pi. ! ! The result is a topology with a higher dimension : ! ! - Vertex -> Edge. ! - Edge -> Face. ! - Wire -> Shell. ! - Face -> Solid. ! - Shell -> CompSolid. ! ! Sweeping a Compound sweeps the elements of the ! compound and creates a compound with the ! results.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Builds the Revol of base S, axis A and angle 2*Pi. If C is true, S is copied.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Builds the Revol of base S, axis A and angle D. If C is true, S is copied.

method.name: Build
method.description: Builds the resulting shape (redefined from MakeShape).

method.name: FirstShape_1
method.description: Returns the first shape of the revol (coinciding with the generating shape).

method.name: LastShape_1
method.description: Returns the TopoDS Shape of the end of the revol.

method.name: Generated
method.description: Returns list of shape generated from shape S Warning: shape S must be shape of type VERTEX, EDGE, FACE, SOLID. For shapes of other types method always returns empty list

method.name: IsDeleted
method.description: Returns true if the shape S has been deleted.

method.name: FirstShape_2
method.description: Returns the TopoDS Shape of the beginning of the revolution, generated with theShape (subShape of the generating shape).

method.name: LastShape_2
method.description: Returns the TopoDS Shape of the end of the revolution, generated with theShape (subShape of the generating shape).

method.name: HasDegenerated
method.description: Check if there are degenerated edges in the result.

method.name: Degenerated
method.description: Returns the list of degenerated edges
